title: viburnum glomeratum subsp. magnificum
intro: Viburnum glomeratum subsp. magnificum, commonly known as Japanese snowball viburnum, is a species of flowering plant in the family Adoxaceae. It is known for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems. The health benefits of this plant include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been attributed to its ability to reduce pain and prevent infections. The therapeutic actions of Viburnum glomeratum subsp. magnificum include its analgesic, antipyretic, and anti-rheumatic actions, which are due to its bioactive constituents, including viburnin, isoferulic acid, and ferulic acid.
